title: 3-Day Nilgiri Queen Ooty Escape
subtitle: Toy train ride, tea estates, botanical gardens & serene lake boating.

dayByDayPlan.title: Arrival in Ooty & Botanical Gardens
dayByDayPlan.description: Check into Nilgiri mountain resort. Afternoon stroll through 22-hectare Government Botanical Gardens and evening hot filter coffee.

dayByDayPlan.title: UNESCO Toy Train & Ooty Lake
dayByDayPlan.description: Morning ride on Nilgiri Mountain Railway from Ooty to Coonoor through tunnels and pine forests. Afternoon lake boating.

dayByDayPlan.title: Tea Factory Tour & Departure
dayByDayPlan.description: Visit Tea Museum and factory to sample fresh orthodox teas before departure.

title: 5-Day Enchanting Kerala Backwaters & Hills
subtitle: Munnar tea plantations, Eravikulam safari & Alleppey luxury houseboat.

dayByDayPlan.title: Kochi Arrival & Scenic Drive to Munnar
dayByDayPlan.description: Arrive at Kochi airport and drive up through Cheeyappara Waterfalls to misty Munnar.

dayByDayPlan.title: Munnar Tea Estates & National Park
dayByDayPlan.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park to spot Nilgiri Tahr. Afternoon walk through Kolukkumalai tea estate.

dayByDayPlan.title: Munnar to Alleppey Houseboat Check-in
dayByDayPlan.description: Drive down to Alleppey jetty and board private luxury Kettuvallam houseboat for backwater cruise.

dayByDayPlan.title: Alleppey to Varkala Cliff Beach
dayByDayPlan.description: Disembark houseboat and drive south to Varkala. Evening sunset walk along Varkala Cliff.

dayByDayPlan.title: Ayurvedic Massage & Departure
dayByDayPlan.description: Morning Ayurvedic rejuvenation massage followed by departure transfer to Trivandrum airport.

title: 7-Day Golden Triangle & Desert Forts of Rajasthan
subtitle: Jaipur palaces, Jodhpur blue city & Jaisalmer sand dune camping.

dayByDayPlan.title: Arrival in Pink City Jaipur
dayByDayPlan.description: Check into heritage hotel. Evening visit to Albert Hall Museum illuminated at night.

dayByDayPlan.title: Jaipur Forts & Palaces
dayByDayPlan.description: Explore hilltop Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds), and Jantar Mantar observatory.

dayByDayPlan.title: Jaipur to Jodhpur Blue City Drive
dayByDayPlan.description: Drive west to Jodhpur. Visit towering Mehrangarh Fort overlooking blue houses.

dayByDayPlan.title: Jodhpur to Golden City Jaisalmer
dayByDayPlan.description: Drive across Thar Desert to Jaisalmer. Evening walk around Gadisar Lake.

dayByDayPlan.title: Living Fort & Sam Sand Dunes Camp
dayByDayPlan.description: Tour living Jaisalmer Fort & Patwon Ki Haveli. Drive to Sam dunes for camel safari & desert camping.

dayByDayPlan.title: Kuldhara Ghost Village & Shopping
dayByDayPlan.description: Visit mysterious abandoned Kuldhara village and shop for leather crafts & silver jewelry.

dayByDayPlan.title: Departure from Jaisalmer
dayByDayPlan.description: Breakfast at hotel and departure transfer to Jaisalmer airport/railway station.
